excerpt: Your idea goes in. A launched product comes out. — Autopilot turns Claude into a product team, not a search box. Give it a raw idea - software, a course, a service, a physical product, an internal process - and it drives you through 11 gated stages, orient to measure, one decision at a time. Under the hood: 4 commands, 4 sub-agents (plan reviewer, codebase reviewer, market researcher, release verifier), and a bundled MCP server that enforces its own rules. Claude Code needed only for software. No API keys. $15 once.

title: ViewHTML
excerpt: Preview, share, and export HTML in seconds — ViewHTML turns raw HTML into a live browser preview—no setup needed. Paste code or open a local file, test CSS and JavaScript side by side, then share a live URL or export a QR code, PNG, or PDF.

title: EverydayTools
excerpt: 50 free client-side calculators, dev tools & PDF utilities — A 100% client-side collection of 50 free web tools: Indian finance (GST, EMI, SIP, Salary), developer utilities (Regex, JSON, Base64, Hash), PDF editing, and unit converters. Zero signups, zero tracking, all calculations happen right in your browser.

title: GitGui
excerpt: A git GUI that lives in your terminal, next to your AI agent — GitGui puts a real git app in your terminal window, next to your coding agent. I got tired of jumping to another app every time I wanted to see the commit graph, stage a hunk, or write a commit message while Pi was still running. It feels like Sourcetree but lives in the same pane layout as your agent. Review diffs, commit and push, switch branches, and watch changes appear as you work. No separate window, no context switch. Built for people who live in cmux, Ghostty, or kitty all day.

title: bbbbb
excerpt: Know when your coding agent needs you — bbbbb (B-five) is an iPhone inbox for coding agents and long-running jobs. Work needing a response stays in Attention; completions go to Activity. Sources can send updates but never read your inbox. No account, ads, tracking, or subscription.
